title: The Trinity
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The Trinity means that the one true God eternally exists as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. God is one in being and three in persons, not three gods, and not one person merely appearing in different forms.
summary: The Trinity means that the one true God eternally exists as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. God is one in being and three in persons, not three gods, and not one person merely appearing in different forms.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals the Trinity clearly because He is the eternal Son sent by the Father and conceived by the Holy Spirit. Through Christ, believers are brought to the Father, by the Spirit, into fellowship with the one true God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The doctrine of the Trinity stands at the heart of biblical faith. Scripture teaches that there is one God, and yet the Father is God, the Son is God, and the Holy Spirit is God. These are not three separate gods competing for worship, but the one true God eternally existing in three distinct persons.

The Trinity is not a man-made puzzle added to Scripture. It arises from the Bible’s own testimony. The Father sends the Son, the Son prays to the Father, the Spirit descends upon Christ, the Spirit is sent to believers, and baptism is commanded in the one name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

This doctrine guards the church from reducing God to something manageable. God is not lonely, divided, changeable, or dependent on creation. From eternity, God is perfect in life, love, glory, fellowship, and blessedness as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

The Gospel itself is Trinitarian. The Father plans and sends, the Son takes on flesh and redeems, and the Spirit gives life and applies the work of Christ to believers. Salvation brings God’s people into communion with the Father through the Son by the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
If the Trinity is denied or distorted, the Gospel is damaged. A Christ who is not truly God cannot fully reveal God or save sinners. A Spirit who is not truly God cannot give new birth, dwell in believers, or sanctify them. A God who is not truly Father, Son, and Spirit is not the God revealed in Scripture.

This doctrine also deepens worship. Believers do not worship an unknown force or distant power. They worship the Father who sent the Son, the Son who redeemed sinners, and the Spirit who gives life, comfort, conviction, and holiness. The Trinity is not cold theology; it is the living God drawing His people into His grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God as He has revealed Himself: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Do not try to shrink God into something easier to explain or control. Pray to the Father through the Son in the Spirit, trust the saving work of Christ, depend on the Spirit’s help, and let the greatness of the triune God lead you into humility, worship, and obedience.
